---
description: "Use when writing or reviewing design specs or implementation plans in eShopOrgMeta."
applyTo: "specs/**,plans/**"
---

- Specs follow `templates/design-spec.md`; keep its front matter and fill every section or write "n/a".
- Plans follow the Superpowers `writing-plans` header/task format and link the spec.
- Use exact terms from `architecture/domain-glossary.md`; add new terms there.
- Any new or changed integration event must also update `architecture/integration-events.md`.
- Cite standards by link instead of restating them.
